loginLink.subject: Sign in to Smartup Hub
loginLink.text:
Hello,

To sign in to Smartup Hub, open the link and press "Sign in":
{url}

The link works for {minutes} minutes and only once. If you did not ask to sign in, just delete this email.

confirmEmail.subject: Confirm your address for Smartup Hub
confirmEmail.text:
Hello,

To sign in to Smartup Hub with a link sent to this address, open the link and press "Confirm address":
{url}

The link works for {minutes} minutes. If you did not enter this address, just delete this email: an unconfirmed address is not linked to anything.

invitation.subject: {inviterName} invites you to Smartup Hub
invitation.text:
Hello,

{inviterName} invites you to the organization {orgName} in Smartup Hub, the Smartup support portal.

To accept the invitation, open the link and press "Accept":
{url}

The invitation is valid for {days} days.
